<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Eye of Masonry](/Feats.aspx?ID=5363) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

</column>

---

Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover [mechanical](/Traits.aspx?ID=646) traps made of stone or hidden within stone, as well as secret doors in stone.

 When using [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) to [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=2375) a stone door or [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) to [Disable a Device](/Actions.aspx?ID=2411) made primarily of stone, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to that check.
name: Eye of Masonry
